ROW.COLUMN: One method of laundering money through insurance products is to initiate one or more policies with "dirty" money with the intention of significantly overpaying premiums within a short period of time (two years) after initiating the policy. Significant overpayments enable money launderers to receive the money that they overpaid back from an insurance company as legitimate funds. The scenario can consider single and/or multiple premium policies. Alerts can be generated on the amount refunded to a customer, the number of refunds received by a customer, the amount refunded as a percentage of expected payment, or any combination of the above, as specified in the scenario parameters.

/*
Dataset Name: ML_PolicieswithRefunds_fCU_dsTRXN - 114691229
Underlying Tables/Datasets: - @MINER@.INSURANCE_POLICY_CUST plcy_cust - @MINER@.INSURANCE_POLICY plcy - @MINER@.INSURANCE_PRODUCT prdct - @MINER@.INSURANCE_TRXN t ** - This dataset is used for binding interested insuarance transactions - it calculates some highlights and scorings, such as

*/ select plcy_cust.CUST_INTRL_ID, plcy.NSRNC_PLCY_INTRL_ID, case when t.MANTAS_TRXN_PURP_CD in ('PREMIUM','NEW POLICY') then t.TRXN_BASE_AM else 0 end as Actual_Amt, case when t.MANTAS_TRXN_PURP_CD in ('PREMIUM','NEW POLICY') then 1 else 0 end as Actual_Ct, (case when t.MANTAS_TRXN_PURP_CD='REFUND' and (t.NSRNC_TRXN_NTITY_RISK_NB > 0 OR t.NSRNC_TRXN_ACTVY_RISK_NB > 0) then t.TRXN_BASE_AM else 0 end) Hr_Trxn_Am, case when t.MANTAS_TRXN_PURP_CD='REFUND' then t.TRXN_BASE_AM else 0 end Trxn_Base_Am, t.NSRNC_TRXN_SEQ_ID
from @MINER@.INSURANCE_POLICY_CUST plcy_cust inner join @MINER@.INSURANCE_POLICY plcy on (plcy.NSRNC_PLCY_INTRL_ID = plcy_cust.NSRNC_PLCY_INTRL_ID) inner join @MINER@.INSURANCE_PRODUCT prdct on (prdct.NSRNC_PRDCT_INTRL_ID = plcy.NSRNC_PRDCT_INTRL_ID) inner join @MINER@.INSURANCE_TRXN t on (t.NSRNC_PLCY_INTRL_ID = plcy.NSRNC_PLCY_INTRL_ID) inner join @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL k on (k.CLNDR_DAY_AGE=0 and k.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL') where -- Current Date - Max Policy Age <= Policy Issue Date months_between(k.CLNDR_DT, plcy.NSRNC_PLCY_ISSUE_DT) <= @Max_Policy_Age -- Lookback Period Tunable Filter and t.TRXN_DT <= k.CLNDR_DT and t.TRXN_DT > add_months(k.CLNDR_DT, -@Lookback_Period) -- All Insurance Types Tunable Filter and (@All_Insurance_Types='Y' or prdct.NSRNC_TYPE_CD in (@Included_Insurance_Types)) -- Included Premium Types Tunable Filter and (prdct.PREM_TYPE_CD in (@Included_Premium_Types)) -- Exclude Variables and Others, Not Listed Above premium payments and plcy.PREM_PERIOD_TYPE_CD not in ('O', 'R') -- Exclude Surrendered Policies and plcy.PLCY_SRNDR_DT is null
